_comment: Optional --map file for: node scripts/importDataset.js --type courses --file <csv> --map import-mappings/courses.json
`columns` maps an exact CSV header (as it appears in your file) to a Course schema field, and takes precedence over the built-in header synonyms below.
`defaults` fills a field for every row whose CSV cell is blank; --department/--year/--semester/--academicYear CLI flags fill those same four fields afterwards, for whatever is still blank.
Built-in header synonyms (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive; see utils/importNormalizers.js HEADER_SYNONYMS.courses) — no --map needed if your headers already match one of these:
department, dept, school -> department (required unless --department is passed)
sem, semester -> semester (required number, unless --semester is passed)
year, studyyear -> year (required number, unless --year is passed)
academicyear, ay, session -> academicYear (number, unless --academicYear is passed)

type, coursetype -> type (lecture|lab|seminar; lab/practical/laboratory -> lab, seminar -> seminar, anything else -> lecture; blank uses lecture on insert and leaves the stored value untouched on update)
